latin: Sicut quilibet philosophus habet dicere quod uirtutes sensitiue sunt in corde, ita quilibet medicus habet dicere quod sint in cerebro.
latin_note: The sheet's line-break slash in 'sensitiue / sunt' is repaired to a space (farmer1998:20108).
translation: Just as every philosopher must say that the sensitive powers reside in the heart, so every physician must say that they reside in the brain.
translation_note: Farmer's note reads this as a secular double-truth harmonizing Aristotle and Galen (farmer1998:20189); both claims form Pico's own reconciling formula rather than a report of a single ascribed view, so pico_stance is given as endorses.
